verdict.rationale: Stagehand is a browser-automation SDK with server-side components such as caching and Browserbase sessions, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for this kind of product. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404, and no doc describes a downloadable spec. The llms.txt file and the AI-rules page are adjacent LLM-oriented docs, not an API specification, so they earn no credit.
